+title: AttachmentView family, UTType resolution, and AttachmentInspector with QuickLook (plan §3.6, §9 F)
+---
+## What
+Create `Sources/AgentViewKit/Attachments/Attachment.swift`, `AttachmentView.swift`, `AttachmentChip.swift`, `AttachmentInspector.swift`, and `ArtifactView.swift`, per plan.md §3.6 and §9 F.
+
+- `Attachment { id, url, type: UTType, name, size }` with `init(url:)` that resolves the type from the extension and the resource values.
+- `AttachmentView(attachment)`: reads `AttachmentRegistry`; defaults by conformance: `.image` preview, `.pdf` thumbnail through `QLThumbnailGenerator`, `.plainText` and markdown through Textual, `.sourceCode` through `CodeBlockView`, `.audio` and `.movie` through AVKit players, else `AttachmentChip` (type icon from `NSWorkspace`, name, size). A tap sets the inspector selection.
+- `AttachmentInspector`: a trailing `.inspector` on `AgentThreadView` bound to a selection in `ExpandedBlocksStore` or a small `InspectorSelection` observable. Hosts `QLPreviewView` and the actions Open (`NSWorkspace.open`), Reveal in Finder, Share (`ShareLink`), Save (`fileExporter`), and pop-out Quick Look (`.quickLookPreview`).
+- `ArtifactView(artifact:)`: a titled panel with `AttachmentView` for the body and the same actions.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A `.swift` file resolves to the source-code renderer; a `.bin` file resolves to the chip.
+- [ ] A registered `.attachmentView(for: .pdf)` wins over the default.
+- [ ] A tap on a chip sets the inspector selection and the inspector shows the file name.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Attachments/AttachmentResolutionTests.swift`: the conformance walk with temp files.
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Attachments/AttachmentInspectorHostedTests.swift`: selection and action presence.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter AgentViewKitTests` exits 0.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
